statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fact001_p5_automation_registry_v1 (automation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(automation_id='FACT001_P5_DAILY_READ_V1'),company_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(company_id='fenix-capital'),engine_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(engine_id='FACT-001'),environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment='LAB'),version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(version='1.0.0'),enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(enabled IN (0,1)),max_daily_jobs INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(max_daily_jobs=1),provider_set TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provider_set='cloudflare,vercel,supabase,notion,github'),updated_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fact001_p5_jobs_v1 (request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(request_id GLOB 'FACT001-P5-*'),day_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(day_key)=8),automation_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(automation_id='FACT001_P5_DAILY_READ_V1'),company_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(company_id='fenix-capital'),engine_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(engine_id='FACT-001'),environment TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(environment='LAB'),version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(version='1.0.0'),provider_set TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provider_set='cloudflare,vercel,supabase,notion,github'),operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(operation='providers.five.inventory.read'),max_cost_eur INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(max_cost_eur=0),state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','COMPLETED','RECONCILE')),attempts INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempts BETWEEN 0 AND 1),ticket_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(ticket_sha256)=64),created_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,expires_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,claimed_at_ms INTEGER,completed_at_ms INTEGER,result_json TEXT,error_code TEXT,CHECK(expires_at_ms>created_at_ms))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fact001_p5_audit_v1 (event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,request_id TEXT NOT NULL,event TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','COMPLETED','RECONCILE')),created_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch('subsec')*1000),UNIQUE(request_id,event))
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS fact001_p5_jobs_insert_audit AFTER INSERT ON fact001_p5_jobs_v1 BEGIN INSERT INTO fact001_p5_audit_v1(request_id,event) VALUES(NEW.request_id,NEW.state); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS fact001_p5_jobs_update_audit AFTER UPDATE OF state ON fact001_p5_jobs_v1 WHEN NEW.state<>OLD.state BEGIN INSERT INTO fact001_p5_audit_v1(request_id,event) VALUES(NEW.request_id,NEW.state); END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS fact001_p5_audit_update_block BEFORE UPDATE ON fact001_p5_audit_v1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'AUDIT_IMMUTABLE'); END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS fact001_p5_audit_delete_block BEFORE DELETE ON fact001_p5_audit_v1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'AUDIT_IMMUTABLE'); END
